scenario: Before the quarterly 1099 run, AP scans the QuickBooks vendor list for duplicate vendors (same tax ID or near-identical names/addresses), merges them into the record with the most recent payment activity, and logs merged pairs in a Google Sheet for the controller.
rule_hooks: tax ID match, name similarity threshold, survivor selection rule

scenario: At month-end, treasury reviews uncleared checks in the bank reconciliation older than 180 days, voids them in QuickBooks, reclassifies the amounts to an unclaimed-property liability account, and notifies the payees' account owners in Slack.
rule_hooks: check age threshold, escheatment account mapping

scenario: After a chart-of-accounts change, the accounting team scans Expensify reports from the current quarter that still use retired GL codes and recodes each line to the new account per a mapping sheet, flagging unmapped codes to the GL owner.
AR scans open Zendesk tickets tagged 'payment-dispute' and closes those whose invoice now shows paid in full in Xero, adding an internal note with the payment date and reference.
rule_hooks: invoice paid status, ticket tag filter

scenario: At quarter close, AR finds open customer invoices with residual balances under $5 caused by rounding or short-pays, writes them off to a bad-debt-small-balance account in QuickBooks, and records each write-off in the close checklist sheet.

Annually, AP marks vendors in NetSuite with no bills or payments in 24 months as inactive, skipping any with open POs or pending 1099 obligations, and posts the list to the #ap channel for objections.
Weekly, the expense team scans Ramp card transactions over $75 lacking receipts, tags them 'receipt-missing', and emails each cardholder a consolidated list with a deadline before the card is locked.

Following a department reorg, finance updates the department/class tag on all open purchase orders and unbilled bills in QuickBooks according to the new org mapping sheet, and messages budget owners whose spend moved.

Treasury matches Stripe payouts from the past month against bank deposits in Xero, marks matched lines as reconciled, and creates a Google Sheet of unmatched payouts or deposits with amount differences for investigation.
rule_hooks: amount and date tolerance, payout ID matching

scenario: The tax team checks every customer marked tax-exempt in the billing system against the exemption certificate tracker, removes the exempt flag where certificates are expired or missing, and emails account managers to collect renewals.

Before each payment run, AP scans unpaid bills in Bill.com for likely duplicates (same vendor, amount, and invoice number or date within 3 days), places the later copy on hold, and alerts the AP lead in Slack.

At month start, the GL accountant reviews prior-month accrual journal entries in QuickBooks lacking an auto-reversal, creates reversing entries dated the first of the month, and updates the accrual schedule sheet.
rule_hooks: accrual memo tag, reversal date convention

scenario: After procurement renegotiates terms, AP updates payment terms on listed vendors from Net 30 to Net 45 in the vendor master and on their open unpaid bills, recalculating due dates and logging changes for audit.
AR deletes draft invoices in Xero older than 60 days that were never sent, except those linked to active HubSpot deals, and sends each creator a summary of what was removed.
rule_hooks: draft age threshold, active deal exclusion

scenario: Monthly, finance scans approved expense reports for policy breaches (meals over the per diem, alcohol, weekend travel without justification), tags offending lines, and opens a review task for each employee's manager in Asana.

During close, the consolidation accountant compares intercompany receivables and payables across the two subsidiaries' QuickBooks files, logs mismatches by counterparty and currency in a sheet, and posts true-up entries for differences under $100.
Ahead of year-end, AP lists vendors paid over $600 who lack a W-9 in the vendor document folder, flags them 'W9-missing' in the vendor record, and sends each a DocuSign W-9 request.
Revenue ops compares Salesforce account billing addresses and billing contacts with customer records in QuickBooks, updates QuickBooks where Salesforce is newer, and lists conflicts for the AR team.

AR scans unapplied customer payments and credits in QuickBooks, applies each to the oldest open invoice for that customer where the amount matches exactly, and leaves partial or ambiguous ones listed for manual review.

After discovering a rate feed outage, the accounting team finds foreign-currency invoices dated during the outage window in Xero, corrects the exchange rate using the treasury rate sheet, and notes the adjustment on each invoice.
rule_hooks: official daily FX rate table, outage date window

scenario: Weekly, AR re-buckets open invoices by days past due, updates the dunning stage tag on each customer in HubSpot, and emails the collections owners the customers that crossed into the 90+ bucket.

Procurement accounting closes open POs where all lines have been received and fully billed, or whose remaining balance is under 2% of the PO total, releasing the leftover encumbrance and notifying the requester.

After HR's weekly offboarding list, finance freezes corporate cards of departed employees in Brex, reassigns their pending expense reports to their manager, and flags unreimbursed balances for final payroll.

The GL accountant reviews the prepaid expense schedule sheet, finds contracts whose monthly amortization entries were missed, posts catch-up journal entries in QuickBooks, and updates remaining balances in the schedule.
rule_hooks: straight-line amortization schedule, service period dates

scenario: Following a nexus review, the tax team identifies open and recent invoices shipped to newly registered states that were billed without sales tax, updates the tax code on open invoices, and logs closed ones for a remediation filing.
rule_hooks: nexus state list, effective registration date

scenario: At month-end, the staff accountant categorizes uncategorized bank-feed transactions in Xero using the vendor-to-account rule sheet, creating bank rules for recurring payees, and leaves the rest in a list for review.

After the annual physical inventory audit, fixed-asset accounting marks assets not located or confirmed scrapped as disposed in the asset register sheet, posts disposal journal entries for remaining net book value, and emails department heads the list.
rule_hooks: audit count results, disposal accounting policy

scenario: FP&A scans card transactions for SaaS subscriptions to find duplicate tools paid by multiple departments, tags them 'consolidation-candidate', and posts a summary to #finance-ops with annual cost per duplicate.
rule_hooks: vendor normalization list, approved software catalog

scenario: AR reviews unapplied customer credit memos older than 12 months, refunds those for active customers per the refund policy, reclassifies the rest to a customer-credit liability account, and notifies account managers.
rule_hooks: credit age limit, customer active status

scenario: When budget owners change at the start of the fiscal year, FP&A updates the owner field on every budget line in the planning Google Sheet and approval routing rules in the AP tool, and messages new owners their lines.
rule_hooks: new owner roster by cost center

scenario: During the external audit, the controller's team reconciles the auditor's PBC request list against documents uploaded to the shared drive, marks items complete or overdue in the tracker sheet, and pings each overdue item's owner in Slack.
rule_hooks: PBC due dates, document naming convention

scenario: Before close sign-off, the assistant controller scans manual journal entries over $10,000 in the period, flags those lacking attached support or approver initials, and creates a task for each preparer in the close tracker.

After the IRS mid-year mileage rate change, finance finds mileage expense lines submitted since the effective date at the old rate, recalculates the reimbursements, and issues adjustment lines on each employee's next report.

AP reviews vendors whose bank details changed in the last 30 days, places their pending payments on hold unless a callback verification is logged in the verification sheet, and alerts the treasury manager.

For the VAT audit, the accounting team scans the year's sales invoices in Xero for numbering gaps or duplicates, documents each gap's cause (voided, deleted) in an audit log sheet, and renumbers duplicate drafts.

Revenue accounting compares closed-won Salesforce contracts against the deferred revenue schedule, adds missing contracts, corrects start/end dates that differ from the signed DocuSign agreement, and flags early terminations.
rule_hooks: contract service dates, rev rec schedule

scenario: Quarterly, finance reviews outstanding employee travel advances older than 60 days, offsets them against submitted expense reports where possible, and emails remaining employees a repayment request copied to payroll.

After an acquisition of a reseller, AR merges duplicate customer records in QuickBooks created from both companies' customer lists, transferring open invoices to the surviving record and updating the Salesforce account ID link.
rule_hooks: customer match keys, surviving record rule

scenario: The tax accountant reviews bills from EU vendors in the quarter, switches those coded with domestic VAT to reverse-charge where the vendor has a valid VAT ID, and lists vendors with invalid IDs for follow-up.

Monthly, the office accounts lead reconciles each location's petty cash log sheet against posted petty-cash expenses in QuickBooks, posts missing entries, flags variances over $20, and messages the location custodian.

Before year-end 1099 filing, AP scans the QuickBooks vendor list against the W-9 tracker sheet and turns the 1099-eligible flag on or off based on entity type and tax classification. It then posts a Slack summary of the changed vendors to the tax channel.

When the weekly HRIS termination report arrives, the agent finds expense reports in the approval queue still assigned to departed managers. It reassigns each one to the next approver in the org chart sheet and emails the submitters.

During the annual chart-of-accounts review, the controller has every GL account in Xero with a zero balance and no postings in 18 months deactivated. Accounts used in recurring templates or bank rules are listed in a review sheet instead.

The agent scans the month's submitted expense reports for the same merchant, date and amount claimed twice, either in two reports or both as a card transaction and an out-of-pocket claim. It rejects the later line and notifies the employee and approver.
rule_hooks: duplicate-match criteria across card and reimbursable

scenario: At month-end, billable hours in the project tool that are older than 30 days and not on any QuickBooks invoice are checked against each client's contract sheet. Entries for capped or fixed-fee clients are marked non-billable, and the rest are queued for invoicing with a Slack note to account managers.
rule_hooks: contract billing type and fee caps

scenario: Each quarter, credit management reviews every active customer's 12-month days-to-pay and current AR aging. It updates the credit limit and credit-hold flag in NetSuite and HubSpot to match the scoring tier.

Procurement cancels purchase requisitions that have sat unapproved or unconverted to a PO for more than 60 days. It releases their budget encumbrance in the budget sheet and emails each requester a resubmit link.

Before close, the accountant reviews every entry in the GL suspense account and reclassifies those whose memo, vendor or bank reference matches a mapping rule to the correct account. Anything unidentifiable after 30 days is escalated to the controller.

Open refund-request tickets in Zendesk are matched to Stripe refunds by charge ID. Tickets whose refund already went out are closed with the refund date, and approved-but-unprocessed refunds older than 5 days are escalated to AR.

AR finds customer accounts with credit balances caused by double payments or paying more than the invoice. It applies the excess to open invoices where possible, or creates refund requests for credits above $500 and emails the customer.
rule_hooks: credit balance thresholds and refund vs apply policy

scenario: Before annual escheatment reporting, the agent finds customer credits and uncashed refunds older than the state dormancy period based on the customer's last known address. It tags them for escheat in the AR system, logs them to the state filing sheet, and sends due-diligence letters.
rule_hooks: state dormancy periods and due-diligence thresholds

scenario: Lease agreements renewed or extended in DocuSign this quarter are matched to the ASC 842 lease register sheet. The agent updates end dates, payment schedules and the remeasurement flag for each, and asks the lease accountant to post the remeasurement entries.

Contractors whose certificate of insurance in the vendor compliance sheet expired or falls below required coverage limits get a payment hold in Bill.com. The agent also emails each vendor a request for an updated certificate.
rule_hooks: required insurance coverage by vendor type

scenario: Salesforce deals that were cancelled or refunded within the 90-day clawback window are matched to the commission payout sheet. The agent records clawback adjustments against the next payout and notifies each rep and their manager.

Incoming vendor bills are compared with their PO and goods receipt. Bills whose quantity or unit price differs beyond tolerance are placed on hold with an exception reason, and the buyer is pinged in Slack to resolve.

The agent reviews all recurring journal entry templates in the GL and deactivates those past their end date or posting to inactive accounts or departments. Templates whose amounts disagree with the underlying contract schedule are flagged to their owner.
rule_hooks: template end dates and active account list

scenario: Every Monday, treasury replaces last week's forecast lines in the 13-week cash forecast sheet with actual bank receipts and disbursements. Categories that varied more than 15% are highlighted, and the forecast is rolled forward a week.
rule_hooks: cash category mapping and variance threshold

scenario: After month-end close, FP&A scans the budget-vs-actual sheet for department lines over budget by more than 10% and $5k. The agent posts a Slack request for variance commentary to each line's budget owner and marks the line as pending comment.

Customer invoices whose delivery email bounced in Gmail are matched to the customer's current billing contact in HubSpot. The agent updates the email on the accounting customer record and resends each invoice.
rule_hooks: CRM billing-contact role as source of truth

scenario: AR works through invoice-dispute tickets in Freshdesk older than 30 days. Where the account manager approved a concession, it issues a credit memo in QuickBooks and closes the ticket; unanswered disputes are escalated.
rule_hooks: dispute approval status and concession limits

scenario: Scheduled AP payments are checked for vendors offering early-pay terms such as 2/10 net 30 whose payment date falls after the discount deadline. Those payments are moved earlier where the cash forecast allows, and the discount is recorded.
rule_hooks: vendor discount terms and cash minimums

scenario: Finance-owned DocuSign envelopes, such as credit applications and vendor agreements, that expired or have sat unsigned more than 14 days are voided. The agent sends fresh envelopes to updated signers and logs the change in the contracts tracker.
rule_hooks: envelope age and signer authority list

scenario: The vendor contract register is scanned for agreements that auto-renew within the notice window. The agent tags each one for renew or cancel review in Asana and emails the budget owner with current annual spend from AP.
Fixed-asset register entries capitalized this year below the company capitalization threshold get a reclass entry moving them to expense. The agent then retires them from the depreciation schedule.

During close, the agent checks each overdue task on the Asana close board for evidence of completion, such as a reconciliation file uploaded or a JE posted. It completes tasks that have evidence and pings the owners of truly late ones with a new due date.
rule_hooks: close calendar deadlines and completion evidence

scenario: The balance-sheet reconciliation tracker is reviewed for accounts whose reconciliation is missing preparer or reviewer sign-off or has an unreconciled difference above threshold. The agent marks those accounts open and notifies the preparers.
rule_hooks: reconciliation materiality and SoD sign-off rules

scenario: AP reviews vendor bills on payment hold and releases those whose hold reason is now resolved, such as a W-9 received, dispute closed or bank details verified. Each released bill goes into the next payment run, and the vendor is notified.
rule_hooks: hold reason codes and clearance evidence

scenario: After the annual price increase, product and service items in QuickBooks whose default rates differ from the approved price book sheet are updated. Items for grandfathered contracts are left unchanged and listed separately.
rule_hooks: approved price book and grandfathering list

scenario: Before the quarter-end expense cutoff, the agent finds draft expense reports and unreported card transactions older than 30 days. It sends each employee a Slack reminder and copies managers when the amount exceeds $1,000.

Invoices issued this month are compared with the deal-desk approval log in Salesforce. Invoices carrying discounts larger than approved are flagged, and either corrected with a rebill or routed to the CFO for retroactive approval.

Each customer's metered usage export is compared with the quantities billed this quarter. Where usage exceeded the plan tier, the agent adds overage invoice lines and notifies the account owner in HubSpot.

Construction-in-progress projects marked complete in the project tracker are transferred from the CIP account to the correct fixed-asset class. The agent sets each in-service date so depreciation starts.
rule_hooks: asset class useful lives and in-service criteria

scenario: Treasury reviews company bank accounts with no activity in 12 months and a balance under $100. The agent sweeps the remaining cash to the operating account, deactivates the GL cash account, and opens closure requests in the treasury tracker.

Vendor invoices sitting in the shared AP Gmail inbox are matched to bills already entered in Bill.com by vendor, number and amount. The agent creates draft bills for the missing ones and labels the emails as processed.
rule_hooks: duplicate detection keys and coding defaults

scenario: Monthly statements from top vendors are compared line by line with the AP ledger. Invoices missing from AP are requested, payments the vendor hasn't applied are reported back to them, and the AP manager gets a summary of differences.

Open invoices for customers flagged as PO-required in the CRM are checked for a PO number. Where one is missing, the agent pulls it from the Salesforce opportunity, reissues the invoice, and asks the account manager for any it can't find.
rule_hooks: customer PO-required flag and portal rules

scenario: Engineering time logged in Jira against projects in the application-development stage is costed from the payroll rate sheet. The agent reclasses that labor from R&D expense to capitalized software, leaving maintenance and research tickets expensed.
Customer invoices past due beyond the grace period are checked for contracts that allow late fees. The agent adds late-fee charges and skips customers with approved waivers or an open dispute ticket.
rule_hooks: contractual late-fee terms and waiver list

scenario: For the quarterly SOX access review, users in the accounting system are compared with the HRIS roster and the role matrix. The agent deactivates terminated users, flags segregation-of-duties conflicts such as creating vendors and approving payments, and logs every change for audit.
rule_hooks: role matrix and SoD conflict rules

scenario: Foreign vendors in AP are checked for a current W-8 on file and for the withholding rate set in the payment system. Rates are corrected to the applicable treaty rate, and vendors with expired forms are switched to 30% backup withholding and emailed.
rule_hooks: tax treaty rate table and W-8 validity
